entries.text: 1. A famous scribe and priest Ezr 7:1-5,6,10,21; Ne 12:36
Commissioned by Artaxerxes, returns to Jerusalem with a large group of Jews Ezr 7:8
His charge to the priests Ezr 8:29
Exhorts people to put away their heathen wives Ezr 9; 10:1-17
Dedicates the wall of Jerusalem Ne 12:27-43
2. A leading priest among the colonists under Zerubbabel Ne 12:1
Probably identical with AZARIAH in Ne 10:2
